payload.summary: Twenty-two clinical sources await owner review; until one is adopted, 47 Therapy records can cite nothing
payload.detail: The acquisition ledger holds 31 sources: 24 candidates, 7 rejections, 0 adopted. Twenty-two carry validationStatus unverified and sit in acquisitionReviewQueue awaiting the owner's clinical sign-off. Sixteen are new captures: 14 NICE guidelines at rung 5, one RANZCP president's update at rung 3, and the WA Aboriginal Health Impact Statement and Declaration Policy (MP 0160/21) at rung 2, whose publication date of 11 May 2021 was read from the policy PDF's own Document Control table. The other six are the Chief Psychiatrist and RANZCP records whose metadata was corrected on 2026-09-16 and whose validationStatus was reset from locally_reviewed to unverified, because the owner's 2026-09-06 attestation predates the correction; they need re-attestation rather than a fresh review. Publication dates and current status for the NICE guidelines were re-read from each publisher's own page on 2026-09-16 and all matched the handover; nine are filed review_due because the publisher's most recent date is over five years old. Nothing is adopted, so no Therapy record may cite any of them yet. This is the gate on the 47 records that currently have null references and null evidenceNotes. Distinct from #SBKXZ7, which tracks clinician sign-off of the 205 therapy records themselves rather than source adoption. Seven further sources are recorded as rejections, each stating what must be established before re-capture; five are blocked because the publisher prints an update date but no publication date. Next action: owner reviews the 22 and decides adoption. npm run check:source-acquisitions lists them under 'Awaiting clinical sign-off'.
payload.source: PsychSift Therapy Claude cloud handover session, 2026-09-16, branch claude/vibrant-mccarthy-bbi43k
